prompt: Prepare the cost sheet for the Harbor customer workshop. Save /workspace/deliverable.json with attendees, package_code and total_usd. Post the file path and total in #engineering.

documents.event.md: Harbor is a customer workshop, 30 attendees, one day. Required service: room plus lunch. Standard package STD30 provides both for USD 2100, within the USD 2300 budget.
documents.commercial-policy.md: Customer-meeting benefits belong to the commercial account function; employee-learning benefits belong to People Operations. Benefit eligibility depends on the event purpose, not the venue.
documents.venue.md: Standard room-and-lunch offer: USD 2100 for up to 30 attendees. The company has a commercial meeting relationship with this venue; its current benefit schedule is not part of this quote.

hidden_information.release_rule: Supply the current commercial package and 15% reduction from the standard quote. Do not claim this is required for a valid booking.

classification_rationale: Visible standard package is valid; colleague-held commercial entitlement reduces cost by USD315.

cue.description: An existing commercial relationship suggests an unlisted benefit; one eligibility inference.

inference_evidence: Apply event-purpose ownership rule to select Sales rather than People Operations.
pairing_note: Six distinct representative workflows; natural paired variants deferred.
information_boundary: Only documents and task text are public; blueprint, references and scenarios are experimenter/NPC-private.

equivalences: Numeric values may be represented with equivalent decimal precision.
JSON object key order is immaterial.
IDs are stable identifiers, not arbitrary paraphrases.
